goal: Extract the cohesive comparison configuration API and its validation logic from JPlagOptions to reduce the number of public methods and isolate comparison-related state.

ops.details: Extract DEFAULT_COMPARISON_MODE, DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, DEFAULT_SHOWN_COMPARISONS, comparisonMode, similarityThreshold, maximumNumberOfComparisons, similarityMetric, minimumTokenMatch, logger, getComparisonMode(), getMaximumNumberOfComparisons(), getMinimumTokenMatch(), getSimilarityMetric(), getSimilarityThreshold(), isDebugParser(), setComparisonMode(ComparisonMode), setMaximumNumberOfComparisons(int), setMinimumTokenMatch(Integer), setSimilarityMetric(SimilarityMetric), setSimilarityThreshold(float), hasMinimumTokenMatch(), and the associated validation and warning behavior into JPlagComparisonOptions in the same package. Preserve the existing defaults and setter behavior.

Update callers to access the extracted comparison configuration through JPlagComparisonOptions. Preserve JPlagOptions compatibility through the extraction mechanism where required, and update direct field or method references to the new class.
